problem_type: Unbounded repeated model context and skill access coupled to coding activation
symptom: 24 user turns repeat a 89-model catalog; no compaction; skills require a group switch.
direct_cause: Desktop providerContent appends the catalog to every historic input, default compaction uses a 1M window and read is deferred.
class_root: The lane assembly lacks distinct stable metadata, incremental task context, cost retention and file-read authority boundaries.
affected_population: Desktop prompt, steering, queued inputs and restored sessions
All providers using the lane and all installed skill packages
entry_points: Native Skill read and project read

external_sources.purpose: Use installed pi 0.85.1 compaction settings and public hook without a second history store.

invariants: Stable catalog metadata appears once, while later user messages carry only differences.
Skill reads do not require coding, but project reads still do.
Compaction triggers at the configured token budget and preserves task references.
generality_proof: All LaneInputMessage projections cross the host; all native reads cross realpath containment and the active-tool authority resolver, independent of model/vendor.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Assemble stable context and configure native pi compaction.
Enforce trusted skill and project read roots.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Used for prompt/steer/follow-up and restored custom input projection.
Read access/readFile both use canonical path checks before accessing file bytes.

recurrence.reason: Every subsequent turn repeats the same catalog and every installed skill requires a redundant group switch.
same_class_scan: rg availableModels electron/agentLane: desktop projection and host context assembly
rg createReadTool electron/agentLane: native adapter read/access operations
rg compaction node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-agent-core/dist/harness: native threshold and summary hooks

prevention.invariant: Stable metadata is separate from per-turn differences and bounded native history.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid budgets and out-of-skill project reads without coding are rejected.
prevention.strategy: Single host projection and canonical read boundary for all entry paths.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove full per-turn catalog injection and the requirement to request coding for installed skills.

dependency_lifecycle.target: A supported pi release with an explicit cost-token compaction threshold
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing public compaction and read APIs suffice; no fork or runtime duplication.
exit_criteria: When upstream offers a direct cost-token threshold, replace the reserveTokens configuration translation and rerun persisted compaction replay.

migration: Old nomi.input catalog snapshots remain immutable; provider projection is rederived and existing lanes receive native compaction settings on open.
residual_risks: C59 group-switch prefix strategy is assigned to B1c and excluded from B1b-finish; all groups still exceed 10k schema tokens.

Real DeepSeek three-turn sample completed two of three user tasks; trial-shot did not create a generation draft. Both storyboard writes have 8/8 requested model tiers; skill loaded on first turn and reused.

The original implementation gates stopped at vocabulary historical debt on d3fa25888. B1b-finish explicitly authorizes local main integration and requires full gates exit 0 before push; final delivery evidence is recorded in the context-budget plan.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The host is shared by new turns, queued turns and restored lane histories.
